owner_calls.question: At Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#10 Peter quits the Oscorp internship and says he can't trust Norman again after the lies about Project Monolith. Should this stage keep kind 'mentor' with the unchanged cards ('Norman's intern. Secretly the Spider-Man Norman mentors.' / 'Peter's mentor at Oscorp.'), or should the kind and cards show that Peter has broken with his former mentor?
options: Keep mentor and the current cards (the mentorship is the through-line, and the split comes only at the very end)
Keep mentor but update the cards to say Peter quits the internship and stops trusting Norman
Change the kind to rival and update the cards to match
owner_calls.evidence: In 'If This Be My Destiny...' (#10), after the gateway disaster Peter decides not to continue the internship. Harry says Norman probably still wants to help Spider-Man, but after all the lies and secrets Peter can't trust Norman again. Norman is not yet an open enemy.
